answer: Lotus-reef layered bond stops bulk fakes: every identity locks 60 credits, 20 per reef layer, in a lotus bond. Each epoch a river pulse picks one layer; the identity must show fresh work for it in the log. A copied or missing layer burns its 20; a layer-sharing ring loses all three. Each extra copy adds 5 to the 38 fee, so 1,000 fakes cost 2,535,500 plus 60,000 locked, dwarfing the 40,000 pool. One honest identity pays 38 once, keeps its bond.
